transcript.text: gas hob keeps clickin on its own since i cleand it, stops then starts agen. drivin me mad. pls help

First switch it off at the wall or cooker switch and let it cool completely. That clicking sound is the ignition system trying to light a flame that isn't being sensed or triggered correctly. Since this started after cleaning, the most likely cause is simply that water or cleaner got onto the igniter electrode or under a burner cap, causing it to spark intermittently. Please do these checks:
1. Lift off all the metal burner caps and crowns (the parts you put pots on). Check if they are completely dry. If there's any moisture, leave them aside for an hour to dry fully.
2. Look at the small white ceramic piece with a metal tip near each burner (the igniter). Wipe it gently with a dry cloth to remove any grease or residue.
3. When you put the caps back on, make sure they are sitting perfectly flat and square. If one is even slightly tilted, it can block the spark or confuse the sensor. Once they are dry and seated correctly, try lighting one burner as normal. Does the clicking stop once it lights, or does it continue to click randomly?

ok did that. i sloshed loads of water round when cleaning and took the caps off. one cap was a bit wonky so i put it back proper. wiped some grease off the igniter too. i unplugged the hob under the sink for the afternoon and the clicking has stopped. no gas smell btw

Water near the plug or socket is dangerous. Please don't touch the plug, socket or machine if they or your hands are wet. If you can do it safely, switch off the circuit at the consumer unit (fuse box), keep away from the water, and don't use the machine again until a qualified electrician or appliance engineer has checked it. That is excellent news. It should stay quiet. Just to stop this happening again in future: always ensure burner caps are bone-dry before putting them back on, and try not to splash water directly over the white ceramic ignition tips when cleaning. If it ever starts clicking again, give it a good wipe with a dry cloth and check the cap is flat. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
